I read this as research/implementation-support — produce a single cited markdown report covering 5 technical areas (Three.js, game-feel, CF Workers DO+Hono, multiplayer sync, Web Audio) with verifiable URLs and version numbers. Plan: parallel-fetch official docs + npm registry + canonical source, then synthesize.

WORKING status: starting broad parallel research pass across npm registry, threejs.org, developers.cloudflare.com, hono.dev, bun.sh, MDN, and GDC/community references for game-feel. No code writing.

Firing first wave of independent fetches.

Good first wave. Confirmed: three `0.185.1`, hono `4.12.32` (deps show wrangler `4.107.0`, bun-types `1.2.20`), Hono CF Workers page confirmed `assets` directive + wrangler.jsonc + port 8787. DO hibernation URL 404'd (path moved) and Bun websockets exceeded buffer. I'll pivot to CF markdown mirrors (small) and GitHub raw for Bun + three.js docs.

Firing wave 2 (parallel).

Section 3 material is now solid (DO hibernation API surface, Hono `upgradeWebSocket` from `hono/cloudflare-workers` vs `hono/bun` exporting a `websocket` handler, wrangler.jsonc bindings+migrations+assets, RPC pattern with `idFromName`/`get`, compatibility_date `2024-04-03`/`2025-04-14`). 

Now wave 3: get three.js release SHA + Bun websockets source (raw via gh, small) + verify game-feel article URLs.

Latest three.js release tag is `r185` (matches npm `0.185.x`); `target_commitish` is `dev`. The `--output`/raw-header variants got rejected by the broker (file-write + custom media-type flags). Pivoting: use `raw.githubusercontent.com` (plain HTTPS) for Bun docs + three.js source, and get the r185 commit SHA for immutable permalinks.

Got r185 SHA `2431a09f46f34c560bc8e44b33be0e567723d5b9` (immutable permalink base). Confirmed `InstancedMesh` API (`instanceMatrix`, `setMatrixAt`, `setColorAt`, `count`, `computeBoundingSphere`, `dispose`) and `CapsuleGeometry(radius, height, capSegments, radialSegments, heightSegments)` from source. Bun websockets raw 404'd (path differs). 

Wave 5: verify material API names + constants (ACESFilmic/SRGB) + three.js Installation doc + Hono Bun getting-started (for Bun.serve websocket pattern).
